def transform(grid):
    cells = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=0]
    if not cells: return [[0]]
    min_r = min(r for r,c in cells); max_r = max(r for r,c in cells)
    min_c = min(c for r,c in cells); max_c = max(c for r,c in cells)
    sub = [row[min_c:max_c+1] for row in grid[min_r:max_r+1]]
    counts = [sum(1 for v in row if v!=0) for row in sub]
    max_i = counts.index(max(counts))
    return [[0 if v!=0 else v for v in sub[max_i]]]
